Synopsis:
Dialog with a group of prisoners in Cazador's Palace when Astarion is not in the party.Also triggered when Astarion is in the party and you already had an Origin Moment with him at this place.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_CazadorsPalace_Cells_NoAstarion.json: You find a group of emaciated, pale vampire spawn imprisoned in Cazador’s Palace; one of them (Sebastian) pleads for help and explains they woke up there after falling into darkness. Each prisoner bears a carved rune scar and shows clear hunger, and they insist Cazador will not let them die. The lines assume the party is in the Palace to confront Cazador and present choices about whether to kill him and what to do with the changed prisoners — they worry about what will happen to them afterward. This scene can play when Astarion is not in the party, or when he is present but you’ve already had his Origin Moment here.
- LOW_CazadorsPalace_Cells_OM_Astarion_COM.json: COM dialog with the prisoners in Cazador's Palace. Astarion meets Sebastian - a young man he seduced and brought to Cazador - for the first time in 170 years. Astarion was sure Sebastian was dead, but Cazador secretly turned him into a vampire spawn. If you aggrevate Sebastian, he'll be so full of hate and pain that he'll curse you.
- EPI_Epilogue_AD_IdleAstarion.json: Astarion at the Epilogue party - a gathering of the companions/origins six months after the end of the game.Lines for Vampire Lord and Vampire Spawn Astarion. (Vampire Spawn lines should assume Cazador is dead, unless noted otherwise.)
- Astarion_Recruitment.json: Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.
- CAMP_Night3_CRD_Astarion.json: Astartion starts the dialog lying on his bedroll, looking up at the stars. He's somewhat pensive, reflective, thinking that he might lose the ability to walk in the sun - even if it means ultimately saving his life. He gets up and is complImentary towards us, but he gets uncomfortably close and his compliments have a hungry feel to them. Really he's thinking that later tonight he'll come back and drink our blood. He excuses himself, but he's sure that tonight's the night he's going to feed.

context: You and your party have found a cell in Cazador’s Palace full of emaciated, pale vampire spawn led by a young man named Sebastian; each prisoner bears a carved rune scar and shows obvious, hunger-driven desperation. Sebastian pleads that they woke up here after falling into darkness and insists Cazador will not let them die, even as they suffer. This scene plays when Astarion is not in the party (or if he is, his Origin Moment here has already happened), so any first-time reunion lines are not present. The exchange frames the party’s looming choice to confront or kill Cazador and raises the practical and moral question of what to do with the changed prisoners if he’s removed.
